metadata.question: Does central Oklahoma experience more rainfall compared to northen Texas during August 10-20, 2007?

data.raw_code: The user is asking to compare rainfall between two regions (central Oklahoma vs northern Texas) during a specific date range (Aug 10-20, 2007). Key considerations: 1. Rainfall data source: Use GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) or TRMM for 2007. GPM IMERG data starts from 2014, so for 2007 we need TRMM (3B42RT) which is available in GEE. 2. Regions: Need to define two geometries - central Oklahoma and northern Texas. 3. Time period: Fixed date range (2007-08-10 to 2007-08-20). 4. Comparison: Need to calculate average/accumulated rainfall for both regions and compare. 5. Data validation: Check if data exists (collection size > 0), valid pixels after masking, and valid results. Plan: 1. Use TRMM 3B42RT v7 daily precipitation data ("TRMM/3B42RT/Daily"). 2. Define two polygon regions (simplified bounding boxes for each area). 3. Filter by date, calculate mean precipitation for each region. 4. Compare the values to answer "more rainfall" (higher value). 5. Handle missing data cases appropriately. Note: TRMM has precipitation band 'precipitation'. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for central Oklahoma and northern Texas const centralOklahoma = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-98.5, 34.5, -96.5, 36.5]); // Approximate central OK const northernTexas = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-101.0, 32.0, -98.0, 34.0]); // Approximate northern TX // 2. Time period const startDate = '2007-08-10'; const endDate = '2007-08-20'; // 3. Load TRMM daily precipitation data const trmmCol = ee.ImageCollection('TRMM/3B42RT/Daily') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('precipitation'); // 4. Check if collection has data const colSize = trmmCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`TRMM Images (2007-08-10 to 2007-08-20): ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No TRMM data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Create a composite (sum of precipitation over the period) const precipSum = trmmCol.sum(); // 6. Calculate mean precipitation for each region const reduceConfig = { reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: null, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }; // Central Oklahoma reduceConfig.geometry = centralOklahoma; const okPrecip = precipSum.reduceRegion(reduceConfig).get('precipitation'); const okVal = okPrecip.getInfo(); // Northern Texas reduceConfig.geometry = northernTexas; const txPrecip = precipSum.reduceRegion(reduceConfig).get('precipitation'); const txVal = txPrecip.getInfo(); console.log(`Central OK total precipitation (mm): ${okVal !== null ? okVal.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Northern TX total precipitation (mm): ${txVal !== null ? txVal.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); // 7. Check for valid results if (okVal === null || txVal === null || isNaN(okVal) || isNaN(txVal) || okVal < 0 || txVal < 0) { // Negative precipitation is invalid console.log("Invalid precipitation values calculated."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 8. Compare and output answer if (okVal > txVal) { console.log("Central Oklahoma has higher precipitation."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Northern Texas has equal or higher precipitation."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
